name: The Curse of the Tides
summary: Off Stranglethorn's coast, Catelyn the Blade lends you her recovered knife to strike a sunken altar. Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay seeks the Stone of the Tides for his collection of ancient troll artifacts.

sections.title: The Sunken Altar
sections.body: Catelyn the Blade lends you her recovered troll dagger to break an altar beneath the waves. She knows less of troll ruins than her father, but has heard of a sunken troll city. So she points you northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp. There, in the Vile Reef's underwater ruins, the Altar of the Tides glows blue among sea life and murlocs.

sections.title: The Trapped Mage
sections.body: Striking the Altar of the Tides with Catelyn's blade breaks its magic and draws forth Gazban, a goblin mage carrying the Stone of the Tides. Challenged, Gazban takes the form of a water elemental. Once you overcome him, you can carry the stone and the borrowed dagger back to Booty Bay. Baron Revilgaz has prepared a special display stand for the relic's captured oceanic magic, among his prized collection.

faq.q: Where is the Altar of the Tides located?
aliases: where do i find the altar
faq.answer: The Altar of the Tides lies beneath the sea in the Vile Reef, a sunken ruin northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp. Its blue glow is easy to see underwater.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz want the stone?
aliases: what does revilgaz do with it
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz collects ancient troll antiquities. He has cleared space and bought a fine stand to display the relic.

faq.q: Why does Catelyn lend her blade?
faq.answer: Catelyn lends you her recovered special knife to shatter the altar, asking you to return it safely when the deed is done.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you complete Baron Revilgaz's search for the ancient relic in waters near the Horde encampment at Grom'gol Base Camp.
